Data_Dictionary.Metric Name: Indian nationals living in the UK (OECD)
Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: Roughly how many people with Indian citizenship live in the UK each year.
Data_Dictionary.Source table: International Migration Database, stock of foreign population by nationality
Data_Dictionary.Release / vintage: OECD IMD as compiled in old UK master
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Survey estimate with sampling error; 2012 and 2018 flagged; series stops after 2018 in this file.

Data_Dictionary.Metric Name: All foreign nationals in the UK (OECD)
Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: Everyone living in the UK without British citizenship.
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Same survey caveats.

Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: Out of every 100 foreign nationals in the UK, how many are Indian.
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Like-for-like (same survey, same year).

Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: People in England and Wales who hold an Indian passport on census day.
Data_Dictionary.Source table: Census 2021: International migration, England and Wales
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: England & Wales only; rounded to thousands; people with dual passports counted once by ONS priority rules.

Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: People holding any non-UK passport.
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Rounded to 0.1 million.

Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: People in England and Wales who were born in India, whatever their citizenship now.
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Includes naturalised British citizens; not comparable with nationality rows.

Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: Indian citizens who moved to the UK intending to stay at least a year.
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Provisional and revised every release; rounded to 1,000; not comparable with pre-2021 IPS estimates.

Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: Why they came, based on their visa.
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Dependants are counted under the main applicant's reason.

Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: Indian citizens who left the UK for at least a year.
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Emigration is harder to measure than immigration; larger revisions.

Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: Arrivals minus departures: how much the Indian population grew through migration.
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Use only as context; other countries' pages use arrivals.

Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: Everyone moving to or from the UK for 12+ months, including British citizens.
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Net as published may differ by 1,000 from arrivals minus departures (rounding).

Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: Out of every 100 long-term arrivals, how many are Indian nationals.
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Denominator includes British nationals, so this is a share of ALL movers, not only foreigners.

Data_Dictionary.Metric Name: Entry clearance visas by route, quarterly
Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: How many visas the UK granted (or refused) each quarter, by type of visa.
Data_Dictionary.Filters applied: Nationality: India or all; outcome: issued / refused / all; applicant type
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Visas are permissions, not arrivals; one person can hold several; latest quarters revised.

Data_Dictionary.Metric Name: Entry clearance visas by route, calendar year
Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: Sum of the four quarters.
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Calendar year, not the Home Office 'year ending June' headline.

Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: Number of work visas granted to the worker themselves (not family members).
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Counts permissions to work, not people in jobs. Includes short-term routes (Temporary Worker, e.g. seasonal).

Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: Out of every 100 work visas the UK granted, how many went to Indians.
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Like-for-like (same table, same filters).

Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: Nurses allowed to practise in the UK who qualified in India / outside the UK.
Data_Dictionary.Source table: Health Workforce Migration: foreign-trained nurses by country of origin
Data_Dictionary.Direct URL: https://data-explorer.oecd.org/ (Health > Health workforce migration: foreign-trained doctors and nurses by country of origin)
Data_Dictionary.Release / vintage: As compiled in old UK master
Data_Dictionary.Filters applied: Country of training: India / all foreign
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Training country, not nationality. 2025 value not yet cross-checked against NMC.

Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: Doctors registered in the UK whose first medical degree is from India / abroad.
Data_Dictionary.Source table: Health Workforce Migration: foreign-trained doctors by country of origin
Data_Dictionary.Direct URL: https://data-explorer.oecd.org/ (Health > Health workforce migration: foreign-trained doctors and nurses by country of origin)
Data_Dictionary.Release / vintage: As compiled in old UK master
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Verify the latest year with the GMC data explorer.

Data_Dictionary.Metric Name: NMC first-time joiners educated in India / internationally
Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: How many nurses, midwives and nursing associates trained in India joined the UK register in the year.
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Includes midwives and nursing associates; 2022-23 missing.

Data_Dictionary.Metric Name: Health and Care Worker visas issued
Data_Dictionary.Plain-language meaning: Visas granted under the health and care route (doctors, nurses, care workers and their families).
Data_Dictionary.Source table: Vis_D02, Worker > Health and Care Worker
Data_Dictionary.Filters applied: Visa subgroup: Health and Care Worker
Data_Dictionary.Known limitations: Mostly care workers in 2022-23; route closed to new overseas care workers 22 July 2025.

Master_Annual.Metric Name: Indian nationals living in the UK (OECD estimate)
Master_Annual.Source: OECD International Migration Database (UK source: ONS Annual Population Survey)
Master_Annual.Notes / quality flag: Survey-based estimate as published by the OECD International Migration Database (stocks of foreign population, B15; UK source ONS Annual Population Survey), rounded to thousands. Checked against OECD on 30 Oct 2026. India 2020 not published; 2018, 2019 and 2021 are all published as 370,000.

Master_Annual.Metric Name: All foreign nationals living in the UK (OECD estimate)
Master_Annual.Source: OECD International Migration Database (UK source: ONS Annual Population Survey)
Master_Annual.Notes / quality flag: Survey-based estimate as published by the OECD International Migration Database (stocks of foreign population, B15; UK source ONS Annual Population Survey), rounded to thousands. Checked against OECD on 30 Oct 2026. India 2020 not published; 2018, 2019 and 2021 are all published as 370,000.

Master_Annual.Metric Name: India's share of the UK foreign-national population (OECD)
Master_Annual.Source: Calculated: POP_IN_OECD / POP_ALL_OECD

Master_Annual.Metric Name: Residents of England and Wales holding an Indian passport (Census 2021)
Master_Annual.Source: ONS Census 2021, International migration bulletin
Master_Annual.Notes / quality flag: Passport held is the closest Census measure to nationality. Covers England and Wales only (Scotland and Northern Ireland run separate censuses). Rounded to thousands in the bulletin.

Master_Annual.Metric Name: Residents of England and Wales holding a non-UK passport (Census 2021)
Master_Annual.Source: ONS Census 2021, International migration bulletin
Master_Annual.Notes / quality flag: Published as 4.2 million (2011) and 5.9 million (2021), so the share below is approximate.

Master_Annual.Metric Name: India's share of non-UK passport holders (Census 2021)
Master_Annual.Source: Calculated: POP_IN_CENSUS / POP_ALL_CENSUS

Master_Annual.Metric Name: Residents of England and Wales born in India (Census)
Master_Annual.Source: ONS Census 2021 (2011 comparison in same bulletin)
Master_Annual.Notes / quality flag: Country of birth, not nationality: includes Indian-born people who are now British citizens. Do NOT compare with the nationality rows. India was the most common non-UK country of birth in 2021.

Master_Annual.Metric Name: Residents of England and Wales born outside the UK (Census)
Master_Annual.Source: ONS Census 2021 (2011 comparison in same bulletin)

Master_Annual.Metric Name: India-born as share of all foreign-born (Census)
Master_Annual.Source: Calculated: POP_IN_BORN / POP_ALL_BORN

Master_Annual.Metric Name: Indian nationals arriving in the UK, all reasons
Master_Annual.Source: ONS LTIM provisional, release 21 May 2026, Table 3e (immigration by nationality and reason)
Master_Annual.Notes / quality flag: Comparable with Germany/other countries' arrivals. This is the all-reason flow the dashboard should use.

Master_Annual.Source: ONS LTIM provisional, release 21 May 2026, Table 3f (emigration by nationality and reason)

Master_Annual.Source: ONS LTIM provisional, release 21 May 2026, Table 3f

Master_Annual.Source: ONS LTIM provisional, release 21 May 2026, Table 3f

Master_Annual.Metric Name: Indian nationals leaving who came for other reasons
Master_Annual.Source: ONS LTIM provisional, release 21 May 2026, Table 3f

Master_Annual.Metric Name: Net migration of Indian nationals, all reasons
Master_Annual.Source: Calculated: arrivals minus departures (ONS LTIM Table 3e minus 3f)
Master_Annual.Notes / quality flag: Net = how much the Indian population grew through migration. Not comparable with other countries' arrivals.

Master_Annual.Metric Name: Net migration of Indian nationals, work
Master_Annual.Source: Calculated: arrivals minus departures (ONS LTIM Table 3e minus 3f)

Master_Annual.Metric Name: Net migration of Indian nationals, study
Master_Annual.Source: Calculated: arrivals minus departures (ONS LTIM Table 3e minus 3f)

Master_Annual.Metric Name: Net migration of Indian nationals, other reasons
Master_Annual.Source: Calculated: arrivals minus departures (ONS LTIM Table 3e minus 3f)

Master_Annual.Metric Name: All nationalities arriving in the UK (long-term)
Master_Annual.Source: ONS LTIM provisional, release 21 May 2026, Table 1
Master_Annual.Notes / quality flag: Includes British nationals returning. Use for India's share of arrivals.

Master_Annual.Metric Name: All nationalities leaving the UK (long-term)
Master_Annual.Source: ONS LTIM provisional, release 21 May 2026, Table 1

Master_Annual.Metric Name: Net migration, all nationalities (as published)
Master_Annual.Source: ONS LTIM provisional, release 21 May 2026, Table 1
Master_Annual.Notes / quality flag: Published by ONS. Can differ by 1,000 from arrivals minus departures because each is rounded separately.

Master_Annual.Metric Name: India's share of all long-term arrivals
Master_Annual.Source: Calculated: FLOW_IN_ARR / FLOW_ALL_ARR
Master_Annual.Notes / quality flag: Same source and year on top and bottom. 2025 = 17%, matching the Migration Observatory's reading of the same ONS release.

Master_Annual.Metric Name: India's share of all long-term departures
Master_Annual.Source: Calculated: FLOW_IN_DEP / FLOW_ALL_DEP
